overview_description.description: GAIA is a technology company founded on the belief that AI has the potential to improve human lives in a variety of ways and across a wide range of applications. They aim to work in collaboration with humans to achieve a future that is more productive, safe, and economically prosperous. Their founding principles revolve around making AI technology accessible and customizable for a range of users, including students, startups, corporations, multinational organizations, and governments around the world. Their objective is to provide a platform for individuals and enterprises to fully leverage the benefits of AI technology.
